Markets.title: Yes Bank bondholders press for compliance with Supreme Court's AT-1 order
Markets.summary: Yes Bank bondholders filed a contempt petition in the Supreme Court after the lender failed to comply with an order restoring 84 billion rupees in AT-1 bonds. Axis Trustee Services, representing the bondholders, is seeking legal enforcement of the ruling that set aside the bank's write-off.

Markets.title: Anthropic’s IPO is said to be multiple times oversubscribed
Markets.summary: Anthropic's initial public offering is multiple times oversubscribed, with the company aiming to raise up to $90.4 billion. The strong investor demand reflects an anticipated market valuation of about $1.4 trillion, supported by an $81 billion revenue run rate.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: Astra Microwave among 3 stock recommendations for Thursday

Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq rise as CoreWeave results ease AI spending concerns
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq rose after CoreWeave reported strong financial results and projected profitability by 2028. This performance eased investor concerns about artificial intelligence spending and boosted AI infrastructure stocks.

Markets.title: Baird downgrades Nvidia on China curbs, AI demand worries
Markets.summary: Baird downgraded Nvidia's stock and cut its price target due to market risks, including US restrictions on chip sales to China. Additionally, softening demand, supply constraints, and removal from multiple brokerages' top picks have negatively impacted the company's outlook.

Markets.title: EasyJet shareholders approve £5.7 billion Apollo takeover
Markets.summary: EasyJet shareholders have overwhelmingly voted to approve a £5.7 billion takeover by Apollo, which will remove the airline from the London stock market if finalized. The deal, targeted for completion by the first quarter of next year, still faces regulatory scrutiny in the European Union regarding airline ownership rules.

Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was relocated to a military base following alleged threats from Iran. He is one of several Trump administration officials currently living on military bases due to safety concerns.

Geo-Political.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of schools in Italy, Scotland, and Northern Ireland received bomb threats that authorities suspect are hoaxes. Officials in all three regions stated there is currently no known risk to the public and have not confirmed if the incidents are connected.

Geo-Political.summary: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has resigned from office. This resignation highlights a growing political rift between President Prabowo Subianto and former President Joko Widodo.
